items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: About how early can you remember any year that that was when you started with Tom Brown and Steve? ... That was 19, around 1912.

ctx.x: Miller was a plumber. And, his brother Steve was, uh, he was a tinsmith too. And they all had jobs. I was the only guy that didn't have a job. So I, well, I got to find out, I got to be the manager of the band.
He told me that you used to get all the engagements and manage that he told us that, too.
